_comment: §6.N.2 bluff-hunt of GATE-SHAPING PRODUCTION CODE, targeting the 'vacuous pass' defect family: a gate that reports success without having established the fact it claims. Twelve defect shapes were probed. Every reported finding was reproduced by direct measurement (fixture + captured verdict), not by reading alone. Findings whose defect is real but currently unreachable in this tree are labelled latent, with the measurement that establishes reachability stated plainly rather than omitted. NO repository file was modified by this hunt: it was read-and-prove only, because other agents were editing several targets concurrently. All fixtures were built in a session scratchpad; mutation-style probes ran against copies or verbatim excerpts.
trigger: §6.N.2 mandatory-minimum production-code hunt. Prompted by six vacuous-pass defects proven earlier the same day (17 grep -q/pipefail sites in .githooks/pre-push; an orchestrator PASS over a REJECTED anti-bluff Evidence Record; advance-all-submodules.sh examining 0 submodules and exiting 0; a zero-iteration push loop reading as success; check-workable-items.sh omitting the *_Summary docs; a run report attributing a PASS to an untested commit). The family was evidently not exhausted.
method: For each target: (1) read the gate's decision path in full; (2) determine which of the 12 shapes the code can express; (3) build a fixture that exercises it; (4) MEASURE the verdict (exit code, stdout verbatim, PIPESTATUS), repeating N times where the defect is a scheduling race; (5) where the whole script could not be driven (hardcoded repo root, gradle/device dependencies), extract the decision block VERBATIM into a harness and drive that, labelling it as an excerpt. Negative results were recorded per file so the hunt has a denominator.

safety_posture.reason: Read-and-prove task; other agents held several targets mid-edit. A concurrent write would have collided.

measurement_hazards_controlled.shadowed_grep: `grep` is a shell function dispatching to a ugrep-argv wrapper whose exit codes diverge from GNU grep. Every exit-code-sensitive probe ran as `command grep` inside `bash -c`.
measurement_hazards_controlled.shape_6_preconditions: SIGPIPE-under-pipefail was claimed ONLY where all three were established: pipefail actually in effect for that code, the consumer short-circuits, and the producer can exceed the pipe buffer. Note scripts/tag.sh sets `set -Eeuo pipefail` (line 12) — an initial `set -euo` grep missed it; the correction is recorded here rather than silently applied.
measurement_hazards_controlled.invalidated_probe_discarded: A first attempt to measure check-challenge-coverage.sh's per-feature detection layer passed a 670 KB corpus through argv and died with 'Argument list too long', which silently pushed features down to a lower detection layer. Those numbers were DISCARDED and the probe re-run through a temp file. The invalid run is recorded because a hunt that hides a retracted measurement is not an honest record.

delegated_findings_pipeline.defect: write_evidence_record unconditionally stamps `anti_bluff_status: "validated"` into every record. The source itself documents this as a PLACEHOLDER, not a verdict (evidence.sh:94-102: 'This is NOT a real verdict ... until a separate, independent component ... overwrites this field for real'). Nothing mechanically requires that validator to run, and phase-02-test.sh:348 counts a record as rejected only when the field starts with REJECTED — so 'validated by the validator' and 'never validated at all' are byte-identical on disk and indistinguishable to the aggregator.

delegated_findings_pipeline.claim: FR-000's clean-tree guard is `git status --porcelain`, whose output is shaped by per-submodule config. .gitmodules sets `ignore = untracked` for submodules/containers (:4) and submodules/challenges (:32). Per git's own documentation of that value, untracked files inside those submodules do not make the tree dirty for this gate — so the pipeline's only safety boundary would let a run proceed from a tree that is not clean.

Not performed: it requires writing into the repo, which this hunt forbids, and the equivalent hermetic fixture requires `git commit` to create a gitlink, also forbidden.
